sourceManifest.scope: package.json, README.md, src/**, tests/**, docs/**; paths sorted and combined with each file SHA-256

coverage: real loopback HTTP enqueue, dispatch, acknowledgement and read
malformed JSON and unsupported route rejection

simulation.result: one synthetic message reached DELIVERED after MESSAGE_QUEUED and DELIVERY_DISPATCHED

limitations: No production messenger, company system, cloud service or external message broker was used.

The Windows sandbox blocked the test runner's per-file child-process isolation with EPERM, so the project uses Node's documented in-process isolation mode while preserving independent node:test cases.
